entry.title: The integration rule names docs/reports/<card>/integration-gate.json; every integration gate since wave 43 is at integration/gate.json
entry.why: MEASURED by card STABILITY-REEVAL-5 (wave-45 close, base 8c1f15eb): docs/agents/operations.md:119 names integration-gate.json; ls finds 54 docs/reports/*/integration/gate.json and 15 older */integration-gate.json. A close sweep following the rule's path finds none of wave 45's. DISCHARGE: the rule text, and any close tooling, name the path in use.

ground: Its discharge condition: 'the rule text, and any close tooling, name the path in use.' DOCS-COMPACT-9 corrected docs/agents/operations.md's integration rule to docs/reports/<card>/integration/gate.json, the path every integration gate since wave 43 uses. No close tooling names either path: `git grep integration-gate` over scripts/, providers/, *.rs and *.sh finds nothing, and no script reads integration/gate.json by a hard-coded path, so the rule was the only place the old path stood.
